lead_profile_text: Existing property looking for higher return
property_situation: 5-year self-hosting couple (wife Superhost), 2 properties on Airbnb at ~£30k/yr each, 60-80% occupancy; wants to hand off by end of November
primary_blocker: Local proof: how many Glastonbury properties does Stayful manage; comparing 3-4 operators
language_signals: we just want to take it easy a bit... Let somebody else run it for us
It's a success. We've developed it
Glastonbury is many events all year round... it's just crazy town
I'm kind of well-versed in how it works
there are some difficulties in operating from Glastonbury

green_light_signals.trigger_phrase: We've been operating Airbnb for 5 years now

meeting_flow.opening_phrase: I thought I'd start just by understanding a bit on your current situation and situation with the property, and then we can go through the figures and our service if it lines up with what you're looking for.
meeting_flow.pivot_to_business: we can go through the figures and go through our service if it lines up with what you're looking for
meeting_flow.income_intro: £58,000 of gross, which is what guests pay in total... that kind of lines up with what we've projected
meeting_flow.how_it_works_transition: I can go through a bit more on the figures, or I can just go through to the service... Which do you prefer?
meeting_flow.pre_close_setup: Manchester 3-bed case study projected vs actual
meeting_flow.meeting_2_ask: No meeting 2; 'I'll send you a summary... figures... examples'

lead_responses.what_lead_said: how many properties do you have in Glastonbury currently?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: About 70 in total; would have to check Glastonbury count
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: I just want to know you can do it... see your figures on a property you have in Glastonbury (asked again)

lead_responses.what_lead_said: What percentage of your bookings come from Airbnb, Booking.com, construction workers?
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: You say there's not very many events in Glastonbury?

lead_responses.what_lead_said: the TV's not working. And it's a £500 television... whose insurance, mine or yours?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Damage deposit + Stayful guest cover insurance + ID checks
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: we get damage from 3-day guests and 1-month guests

lead_responses.what_lead_said: finding cleaners is hard... the best ones... we're not taking any more work on
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Approved contractor database with Google review thresholds, per-stay price incl. linen/supplies
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: certainly if you could dig up some examples of Airbnbs you have in Glastonbury

lead_responses.what_lead_said: 15%, I think, is reasonable. Do you charge VAT on that?
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: So it's 17%... 18%. Okay, I think that's good.

conversion_gaps.gap: Proof Stayful operates in Glastonbury (count of local properties, local examples)
conversion_gaps.evidence: asked twice how many Glastonbury properties; 'I really want to speak to people who are in the area already'
conversion_gaps.how_to_fill: Pull Glastonbury portfolio count and send anonymised local examples within 24h (Zac cannot share another landlord's figures, but can share count/ratings/reviews)

conversion_gaps.gap: Damage liability on direct bookings (whose insurance)
conversion_gaps.evidence: £500 TV question; 'damage from 3-day guests and 1-month guests'
conversion_gaps.how_to_fill: Put explicit direct-booking damage/insurance wording in the action plan

conversion_gaps.gap: Reliable local cleaners in a tight cleaner market
conversion_gaps.how_to_fill: Name vetting process and a local cleaner shortlist

positive_shift_moments.lead_response: Right, that's good news (Zac) / agreed fee reasonable

positive_shift_moments.what_caused_shift: Manchester case study projected vs actual within 10%

friction_moments.what_caused_friction: Could not answer Glastonbury property count; refused to share another landlord's figures
friction_moments.lead_response: I just want to know you can do it
friction_moments.recovery_attempted: Offered Manchester case study and promised to send local examples

friction_moments.what_caused_friction: Deck labelled property '4 The Terrace, Bellerby, Leyburn' and framed Glastonbury demand as festival-week only
friction_moments.lead_response: Glastonbury is many events all year round
friction_moments.recovery_attempted: Corrected in action plan and email

opening_phrases: I thought I'd start just by understanding a bit on your current situation and situation with the property, and then we can go through the figures and our service if it lines up with what you're looking for.
transition_phrases: I can go through a bit more on the figures, or I can just go through to the service. Might be a bit better for you.
reassurance_phrases: it's normally within sort of 10%, I would say, either way
zac_language.numbers_framing: Gross → his own results align → 15% management only extra
zac_language.objection_handling_pattern: Case-study proof of projected vs actual; transparent about what cannot be shared

what_they_needed_most: explanation of net benefit vs his current ~£30k
profile_psychology_intersection.recommended_meeting_adjustment: For experienced EX-STL hosts whose income matches the projection, lead with 'time back + local operating proof', have the area property count ready before the call, and make the offer if GL-SELF + GL-TIME present.
